text: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥13日在北京会见清华大学经济管理学院顾问委员会委员代表。 丁薛祥重点围绕人工智能发展和治理同各位委员进行交流。他指出，人工智能是引领新一轮技术革命和产业变革的关键力量，要把这项塑造未来的技术发展好、运用好、治理好，更好造福全人类。欢迎大家支持和参与世界人工智能合作组织建设，促进共同繁荣、维护共同安全。顾问委员会成立26年来，成为中外对话交流合作的重要平台，希望各位委员为中国教育事业和经济发展作出更多贡献。 顾问委员会主席库克等赞赏中国人工智能等领域发展成就，表示愿继续深耕中国、拓展合作，更好发挥桥梁纽带作用。 (新华
text_en: Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met in Beijing on the 13th with representative members of the Advisory Board of Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management. Ding focused his exchange with the members on AI development and governance. He pointed out that AI is a key force leading a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation, and that this technology shaping the future must be developed, applied and governed well to better benefit all humanity. He welcomed everyone to support and participate in building the World AI Cooperation Organization to promote common prosperity and safeguard common security. Over the 26 years since its establishment, the advisory board has become an important platform for dialogue, exchange and cooperation between China and other countries, and he hoped the members would make greater contributions to China's education and economic development. Advisory Board Chairman Cook and others praised China's achievements in AI and other fields, saying they are willing to continue deepening their presence in China and expanding cooperation, and to better play the role of a bridge. (Xinhua
